symptom: GET /api/categories returns HTTP 500 while the backend and database containers remain healthy.
evidence: The bounded backend log shows MySQL error 1146 for vibe_business.Categories. Source inspection found a Categories entity but no migration that creates the table.

root_cause.summary: The running database schema does not contain the Categories table required by the UC-04 category lookup.

actions: Confirmed all three Compose services are running and healthy.
Confirmed backend and frontend production images build successfully.
Confirmed backend and frontend lint pass in disposable Docker containers.
Stopped before schema mutation because repository policy requires an approved schema proposal.
reusable_resolution: Prepare docs/02-construction/implementation/UC-04/schema.json and obtain explicit researcher approval before adding or applying the Categories migration.
prevention: Validate required entity tables against existing migrations before activating runtime verification for a UC that introduces a new lookup entity.
